properties.name: PTAR Agua Prieta (Zapopan)
properties.desc: Designed for NOM-001-SEMARNAT-1996 (Type B receiving body); Jalisco planning sheet says it requires modernization (≈MXN 678 M) to comply with NOM-001-SEMARNAT-2021; potential annual discharge-fee liability ≈MXN 958.5 M if non-compliant. Self-reported RETC releases to water by the operator are the largest in the region (e.g., 2022: ≈17.1 t Ni, ≈11.6 t Cr, ≈12.1 t Pb, ≈1.3 t Cd, ≈130 kg Hg) — these are loads passing through the plant, likely estimated from flow × concentration. CEA/FONNOR 2022 diagnostic found cadmium 0.027 mg/L at station E16 (Río Santiago, Ixtlahuacán del Río) and inferred Agua Prieta discharges as the nearest source. Northwest AMG discharges (San Andrés, San Gaspar, Osorio) and the Río Blanco PTAR expansion were still pending federal funding as of 2024.
